english.title: Fail to comply with section 180(2) consent
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been given consent under section 180(2) of the Highways Act 1980 to carry out works at a street, namely **(..SPECIFY STREET..), to provide means for the admission of air or light to premises, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), situated

(A)_[under]_
(B)_[abutting onto]_

the street, failed to comply with a requirement imposed by **(..SPECIFY LOCAL AUTHORITY..), the local authority, in giving that consent in that **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 180(4)(b)(ii) of the Highways Act 1980.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
having been given consent under section 180(2)
failed to comply with a requirement imposed by the local authority in giving that consent

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Proceedings for this offence shall not without the written consent of the Attorney General, be taken by any person other than the person aggrieved, or a highway authority or council having an interest in the enforcement of the provision or byelaws in question - section 312 Highways Act 1980.
(ii) The meaning of "highway" is defined in section 328 Highways Act 1980.
